scripts.build: npm run clean:assets && npm run copy:fonts && npm run build:css && npm run build:js
scripts.theme:push:code: npm run build && shopify theme push --nodelete --only assets --only sections --only snippets --only layout --only locales --only config/settings_schema.json
scripts.theme:push:all-unsafe: echo 'WARNING: overwrites Theme Editor JSON. Prefer theme:push:code.' && shopify theme push
scripts.theme:pull:content: node scripts/with-content-unlocked.mjs pull --only config/settings_data.json --only sections/footer-group.json --only sections/header-group.json --only sections/overlay-group.json --only templates --force
